protocol_type: Command-Address + DDR data memory protocol. After the host asserts CS#, it sends a 48-bit Command-Address on DQ[7:0] over three clocks (R/W#, Address Space, Burst Type, row+column address); the device inserts the configured initial latency (fixed or variable, the latter signalled by RWDS during CA); then DDR data flows on DQ[7:0] with RWDS as the read strobe (reads) or write byte mask (writes) until CS# deasserts.

channels.name: CK / CK# (clock)
channels.description: Differential clock (single-ended CK at 1.8 V); data is double-data-rate on both edges.

channels.name: CS# (chip select)
channels.description: Active-low, one per device; held low for the whole transaction; selects which device on the shared bus participates.

channels.name: DQ[7:0] (command/address/data)
channels.description: 8-bit DDR bus carrying the 48-bit CA, then read or write data one byte per clock edge.

channels.name: RWDS (Read-Write Data Strobe)
channels.description: Variable-latency indicator during CA, read data strobe during reads, write data byte mask during writes.

channels.name: RESET# / INT# (optional)
channels.description: Hardware reset (active low) and optional interrupt / status output.

command_address.order: most-significant byte first on the first rising edge after CS# low

fields.CA[46]: Address Space (AS) : 0 = Memory array, 1 = Register space
fields.CA[2:0]: Lower Column Address (byte address within the burst)

command_address.operation_select: CA[47] (R/W#) x CA[46] (Address Space) selects memory read, memory write, register read, or register write.

latency.fixed_latency: Always inserts 2x the configured initial latency (deterministic timing).
latency.variable_latency: Inserts 1x or 2x; the device drives RWDS during the CA phase (RWDS asserted = 2x / additional latency required, e.g. HyperRAM refresh collision; RWDS low = 1x).

rwds_function_by_phase.command_address_phase: Memory drives RWDS to indicate 1x vs 2x latency (variable-latency mode).
rwds_function_by_phase.read_data_phase: Memory drives RWDS as the edge-aligned source-synchronous read data strobe.
rwds_function_by_phase.write_data_phase: Host drives RWDS as the byte data mask (RWDS high = mask/skip the byte, RWDS low = write the byte).

burst.linear: Address increments linearly until CS# deasserts.
burst.wrapped: Wraps within the configured burst-length boundary.
burst.hybrid: Begins as a wrapped burst then continues linearly past the wrap boundary.

addressing.note: HyperBus addresses the memory array by the row+upper-column address in CA[44:16] plus the lower-column byte address in CA[2:0]; the register space is selected by Address Space=1 (CA[46]) and addresses the ID/Configuration registers.
